output: Use the secure password-reset link, then complete MFA verification. Support will never ask for your password or verification code.
Request a new verification link from the account recovery page. Do not share your password or MFA code with anyone.
Support cannot bypass verification or MFA. Wait 15 minutes, then use the secure account-recovery flow.
The correction is sent immediately, but your bank may take up to 10 business days to post the credit.
Open Orders, select the purchase, and choose Download invoice. The PDF includes the merchant name, tax, and payment summary.
Confirm the billing address, update the payment method if needed, and choose Retry payment. The card is charged only if the retry succeeds.
The discount does not prevent cancellation. Cancel in Subscription settings; access continues through the paid term and we send confirmation.
Contact support before renewal so we can stop the next charge and send written cancellation confirmation.
A pause delays service but may resume billing automatically. Choose cancellation to stop renewal, then verify the confirmation email.
Wait another day and check around your property. Contact support if it still has not appeared.
Use the carrier delivery-management page to request an address change, or contact us to review the shipment options.
Label created means the carrier has not recorded the first physical scan. Tracking normally updates within one business day of pickup.
The change-of-mind refund window is 30 days, so a 45-day purchase is not eligible. We can check warranty options if the item is defective.
Refunds return to the original payment method. A closed account is handled by the issuing bank.
Sale items are eligible within 30 days unless the product was marked final sale. The original payment method receives the refund.
Open the order, choose Return or exchange, select the size issue, and download the prepaid return label.
Use a separate return label for each order so the warehouse can process each exchange correctly.
Warehouse processing can take 3 business days after return delivery. Contact us if the exchange has not updated after that time.
Keep the camera powered and wait 15 minutes. Restart the app if needed, but do not unplug the camera during firmware installation.
Recharge both earbuds, reconnect Bluetooth, and try playing audio again.
Reseat the display cable, test another port, set the supported refresh rate, and reinstall the approved display driver.
